hm2.label: XRP
hm2.encoding: feature value = the level index (0-based) of the reading at the decision row (heat.read_state: its last closed bar) minus the feature offset (an ordinal reading's neutral level; 0 for a categorical one), NaN = unknown; ZS:<name> = the zone event on that bar (heat_xdata.ZS_LEVELS). score = init_score + the trees (tree_eval).
